text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Happy birthday, Tran-san♪ The party 
preparations are all set and ready!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
First, the bright blue cake! When it went 
viral, you were super curious about what 
it tasted like, weren't you, Tran-san?♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
I even rented a projector! Now you can 
watch all your favorite movies on the big 
screen as much as you want, Tran-san!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Whoa, all of that!? Thanks a bunch~.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Still, did I make you worry? You didn't 
have to push yourself so hard, you know~?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Curren really wanted to do it! I just 
wanted to share my feelings of gratitude.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Useful filming gadgets, hot tips on what's 
going to trend... Tran-san has helped me 
so much that I'm completely in her debt.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Don't sweat it. It's fun for me to see the 
info I share go viral anyway.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Plus, well... I *am* technically your 
senior, right? So if you're counting on 
me, ya know, how could I say no?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Ehh, is it just because I'm your 
senpai...? You always give me information 
for such tiny favors in return, right? 
Doesn't that mean...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Ah, yeah yeah, you don't have to say 
everything. ...You're throwing a party for 
me, right? Come on, let's just go.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe. To return the favor for everything 
you usually do, Curren's gonna pamper you 
today, Tran-senpai♪
